facts.text: Under the Stockton Promise, first- or second-year New Jersey students with an adjusted gross income of $0 to $65,000 have 100% of the gap between financial aid and tuition and fees covered.

sources.title: The Stockton Promise - Office of Financial Aid | Stockton University

facts.text: Stockton University guarantees on-campus housing across all four years, offering options ranging from single and double rooms to apartment-style living.
